_about: 3-26 (level25b), wave 4a round 1: won on tick 371 (win_by 384, slack 13) with two shots and no death. The door's card reads medal 3 (gold: all five crystals, 2 portals, 5,936 ms); no achievement unlocks. EXCEPTIONAL: the knight in the pocket sights him once (tick 206, as he drops into its row) and shoots once (247) at where he stood, 113 units behind him by then; he walks on and is never in reach of the shot (it ends on 297 with him at x 259). The sighting cannot be avoided on this level (below).

THE LEVEL: he starts on a ledge (x 66..384, top y 128). Its right half lies in the ring of shock_agent_2048 (centre (280, 54), areaRadius 105: deadly from x 191 along the ledge), and a pillar (x 176..208, rising to y 80) stands in the way. The only way off the ledge on foot is its left end, into a pocket (x 0..71) shut by door_locked_ent_2052 (x 71..101) whose keyhole is at (18, 204); past the door the floor runs under the ledge, with three crystals, to the exit door (448, 176). The yellow key is carried by knight minion_spawn_913, which patrols the ledge between (232, 112) and (314, 112) with 5,000 ms holds (the ring kills only the player): it stands asleep at x 238.8 from tick 78 to 358.

THE WAY: the knight takes its key to the keyhole through a pair of portals (a key opens a keyhole within 26 units of it whoever carries it, keys.json). Portal B in the pocket at (26, 192): tap 30 from x 75.6 (hold left 1-16, the left end of the ledge's flat top; from x 78 several aims in the pocket clear the ledge's corner by 0.35 units or end 'after the head-height retry', from 75.6 they are clean), placed on 54. Portal A over the knight: the pillar shuts every direct line to it, so the shot goes to reflect_agent_ent_2058 at (192, 12), plane horizontal: tap 62 at (169, 13) from the start point (114.0, 110.4) (hold right 32-47 walks him back to it), caught on 87, its leg is the tap's offset from the shooter mirrored in y (G9), so A opens at (247, 109.4), 14.5 units from the knight's centre, on 115. The knight, asleep, goes through (the port wakes a sleeper for a portal's traveller), is put at B (26, 193.1) and its key is spent on 116 at (26, 182.6), 22.8 from the keyhole; the lock and the door vanish on 209. In the idle ticks he picks the crystals (82, 112) on 5 and (144, 112) on 69 (hold right 66-76, then the walk left). Then hold left 164-200 from x 140.3 (31 ticks reach the ledge's end): he drops into the pocket (landed 210, the door gone on 209), hold right to the door: crystals (160, 208) on 246, (224, 208) on 273, (288, 208) on 300, the door on 371. The player is never outside the camera's view.

THE SIGHTING: the knight now stands in the pocket at (26, 217) and searches (right for 2,000 ms, then left, G1a), looking along the three 128-unit buckets of its row, and the floor under the ledge up to x 384 is in them: the corridor takes 137 ticks to cross and a left-looking phase is 125, so the walk cannot be unseen. A scan of the drop's start from 150 to 420 (every 10 ticks, on this file) found a sighting every time and no death (before tick 295 as he drops in, or on 424 as the knight turns right with him at x 338). The shot flies 1.92 units a tick to where he stood (G1b) and he walks 2.4: a stop of 50 ticks from tick 247 gets him hit on 290 (40 does not); the route has no stop. The idle ticks (116 to 164) are the door's fade: 93 ticks from the key's spending to the keyhole's end. WINDOWS (one input moved, the others fixed; out/parity/program/R4/r1_3-25/window.py): tap 1 on ticks 25-36, tap 2 on 56-88, the walk left's start any earlier tick (the door gates the win) to 168 and its end 195 and later (31 ticks needed), the first walk's end 12-18, aims of +-8 units and more (B x 14-38, y 180-204; A x 161-179 at y 13, y 4-22 at x 169). Leans on rules no clip shows: the reflected leg (G9-4, R3c-10), the knight asleep taken through a portal (3-08, 3-10 and 4-28 rest on it too), and the knight's search schedule (a sighting on a route that does not depend on its time: any of its phases would do). No DEV flag, PutPlayer or skipped tick.
